title: from today
lyrics: I know you listen and I know you hear me through all the trees and the noise Find a way to count you in, a way to let you know I'm alright when you're gone When you're gone I lift up, up in the night We're living moments I cannot fight the darkness creeping on me I, I try, oh I try to avoid, let the thoughts just disappear but it's too hard, yeah Oh my, oh I think about you, dream about you I know you listen, it's a sin, it's a sin, no I wonder how much this is a crime, to think it's all this I wonder if I'll reach out from the edge of the abyss for one last kiss I wonder sometimes if you can see me through the fog and what's there and what's still here It's clear I know you will

lyricsSegments.text: I know you listen and I know you hear me through all the trees and the noise
Find a way to count you in, a way to let you know I'm alright when you're gone
When you're gone I lift up, up in the night
We're living moments I cannot fight the darkness creeping on me
I, I try, oh I try to avoid, let the thoughts just disappear but it's too hard, yeah
Oh my, oh I think about you, dream about you
I know you listen, it's a sin, it's a sin, no
I wonder how much this is a crime, to think it's all this
I wonder if I'll reach out from the edge of the abyss for one last kiss
I wonder sometimes if you can see me through the fog and what's there and what's still here
It's clear I know you will
